question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Clumsy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Graceful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Clumsy"** means awkward in movement or handling things; lacking skill or finesse. (अनाड़ी)

 
 
• **Example:** He is so **clumsy **that he always knocks things over.
 
 
 
• **"Graceful"** refers to having or showing grace or elegance. (सौम्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The dancer's movements were so **graceful **that everyone was mesmerized.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Clumsy'** is **'Graceful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Jealous** (ईर्ष्यालु): Feeling or showing envy of someone or their achievements and advantages.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt **jealous **of her friend's new car.
 
 
 
• **Fierce** (उग्र): Having or displaying an intense or ferocious aggressiveness.
 
 
• **Example:** The **fierce **lion roared loudly in the jungle.
 
 
 
• **Nervous** (चिंतित): Easily agitated or alarmed; tending to be anxious.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt **nervous **before his final exams.
